$comment: Release gates. 'technical' gates allow deployment of the software to production infrastructure. 'clinical' gates must ALL be signed off before real patients use medical features. Evidence = path to a committed, reviewed document. Never mark a gate passed without evidence.

technical.title: Unit, API, AI-safety and ML tests pass in CI
E2E patient journey and automated WCAG 2.2 AA checks pass
Dependency vulnerability scan wired into CI
Production config refuses unsafe settings (local auth, demo models, unapproved KB)
Backups + restore drill performed on staging
Firebase legacy database rules deployed (deny-all) after data export
Error monitoring and uptime alerts configured

clinical.title: Exercise library reviewed and approved by licensed rehabilitation specialists
Screening questionnaire, starting levels and adaptation thresholds approved
Prediction model trained on real, consented clinical data and externally validated
Assistant red-team evaluation by clinicians (emergency, medication, mental-health prompts)
Regulatory classification decided (SaMD or not) for each target market
Legal review: privacy policy, terms, DPIA, DPAs with sub-processors
Usability testing with stroke survivors (aphasia, hemiparesis, low vision)
